page.subtitle: A verified driving licence lets you book self-drive vehicles in just a few steps.

intro.title: Verify your driving licence
intro.body: Take a photo of the front of your driving licence. You only need to do this once — it usually takes less than a minute.
intro.bookingBody: Self-drive rentals need a valid driving licence. Take a photo of the front of your licence — you only do this once for all future trips.

accepted.title: Accepted documents
accepted.vn: Vietnamese licence: PET card, the 2025 card or a screenshot from the VNeID app
accepted.idp: International Driving Permit (IDP): the page with your photo and particulars — bring your original licence at pickup
accepted.foreign: Foreign licence: bring the original (and an IDP under the 1968 Convention) at pickup so the owner can check it

picker.dropTitle: Drag a photo here or click to choose
picker.tapTitle: Tap to photograph the front of your licence
picker.hint: Front side · JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC

prepare.unsupported: This photo cannot be opened. Retake it or choose a JPG or PNG photo.
prepare.tooSmall: The photo is too small to read — move closer.
prepare.tooLarge: The photo is too large — choose another one.

progress.title: Verifying your licence
progress.hint: This usually takes just a few seconds. Stay on this page — the result appears automatically.

verified.title: Your driving licence is verified
verified.body: You can book self-drive vehicles that match your licence class.
verified.bookingTitle: Your licence is valid for this trip
verified.replaceFailed: The new licence photo you sent could not be verified: {reason} Your current licence remains valid.
verified.replacePending: The new licence you sent is awaiting verification by XePrime. Your current licence remains valid.

fields.foreignNote: For international and foreign licences, the owner checks the class and expiry against your original licence at pickup.

pending.title: Waiting for XePrime to verify
pending.body: We will check your photo as soon as possible. This page updates automatically when there is a result.
pending.bookingBody: You can send your rental request as soon as your licence is verified.

rejected.title: We could not verify your licence
rejected.requestReview: The photo is clear — ask XePrime to check
rejected.reviewRequested: Your request for a check has been sent.
rejected.expiredMisread: Is the date on your licence different? The reader may have misread it — ask XePrime to check.

reasons.not_a_licence: We could not find a driving licence in this photo. Take a clear photo of the front of your licence — not an ID card, passport or other document.
reasons.back_side: This is the back — photograph the front, the side with your photo and number.
reasons.unreadable: The photo is not clear enough to read the licence details.
reasons.missing_fields: We could not read the number, name, class and expiry date from the photo.
reasons.no_drivable_class: The licence class does not cover rental cars or motorbikes.

issues.blurry: The photo is blurry — hold the phone steady and tap the card on screen to focus.
issues.glare: There is glare — tilt the card slightly or turn off the flash.
issues.cropped: A corner is cut off — move back so all 4 corners show.
issues.too_dark: The photo is too dark — shoot somewhere with good light.
issues.obstructed: Part of the card is covered — move your fingers or the object away.
issues.low_resolution: The photo is too small — move closer.

tripIssue.expired: Your licence expires on {date}, before the trip ends. Please update to a valid licence.
tripIssue.expiredToday: Your licence expired on {date}. Please update to a valid licence.
tripIssue.classMismatchCar: Your current licence class does not cover cars. Please update to a licence with a suitable class, e.g. B, B1 or B2.
tripIssue.classMismatchMotorbike: Your current licence class does not cover motorbikes. Please update to a licence with class A1, A2 or A.

error.load: Could not load your licence details.
